benefits.name: Telepathic Communication
benefits.description:
You can't produce vocal sounds but instead telepathically communicate with one, some, or all intelligent creatures within short range as easily as if you were talking back and forth out loud.

Naron telepathy doesn't allow you to read others' thoughts or even talk with them if they want to shut you out. But if you are a naron who wants to explore your latent telepathic gifts, choose Psion as your type and/or a psi-heavy focus such as Commands Mental Powers.

However, other foci could be adapted or reskinned so the abilities granted are considered to be generated by your latent psi.

system.description: You are descended from a species of natural telepaths that communicate naturally mind-to-mind, not via spoken language. Standing about 5 feet (1.5 m) tall, your prominence-usually a subtle glow that faintly silhouettes your bald head-moves in slow waves when you're relaxed, or flashes and pulses when you're excited or stressed (unless you consciously suppress it). The naron are generally a peaceful people, but some of you have found the wider galaxy offers interesting opportunities in all walks of society among creatures where psi is a rare to vanishing trait.
